name: the-framework
description: The Framework: autonomous AI programming — coding agents work your repos unattended and hand the result off as pull requests.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/framework typecheck && pnpm -C packages/the-framework.ai typecheck
scripts.clean: pnpm -C packages/branch-management clean && pnpm -C packages/agent-driver clean && pnpm -C packages/framework clean
scripts.test: pnpm -C packages/branch-management test && pnpm -C packages/agent-driver test && pnpm -C packages/framework test
